_comment: Hand-authored, not generated by write_recalibration_seeds() -- these two values were already real, human-confirmed recalibration results (M7's real 76-gameweek walk-forward backtest, activated for real via commit 7bf7604 -- see README's own Status section for the before/after numbers: xi 0.0018->0.005, fit NLL nearly halves 1302->677; rho_residual 0.15->0.0, independent confirmation of M6's own dilution finding). The recalibration_proposals rows that originally recorded them only ever lived in the since-lost local db/fpl_quant_v2.duckdb (correctly gitignored, rebuilt fresh every run) -- this file is what closes that exact provenance gap: the real, already-confirmed values now live here instead of only as inline literals in scripts/run_ingestion.py. fact_type_multiplier_params v8 and minutes_model_shrinkage_params v10 are NOT included here -- their real winning values were never durably recorded anywhere before that same DB was lost (see run_ingestion.py's own comment), and re-establishing them needs an actual re-run of recalibrate() against real data, not a guess at plausible-looking numbers.

provenance.source: commit 7bf7604 (real activation of M7's recalibration proposals)
provenance.note: Pre-dates scripts/record_provenance.py (A5); no machine-generated provenance manifest exists for the original run that produced these values.
